style: STYLE: a cheerful hand-drawn STICKER illustration for a nature-exploration game about native Philippine trees on a university campus. Chunky rounded shapes, friendly and bouncy, like a premium kids' nature app sticker sheet. Every subject has a confident dark forest-green outline (about 2% of canvas width, uniform, rounded joins) and then a thick clean WHITE sticker border around the whole silhouette. FLAT CEL SHADING ONLY: each surface is one base colour plus at most one darker shadow shape and one lighter highlight shape, all hard-edged. COLOURS: use only lush leaf greens, deep forest green, teal, sky blue, sunny yellow, warm orange, cream, warm wood brown and a little tomato red. BANNED: any pink, magenta, purple or violet anywhere inside the subject; gradients; airbrush; soft glow; drop shadows; noise; paper texture; stippling; hatching; photorealism; 3D render look; text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks of any kind; chess pieces or boards; dark or black backgrounds.
framing: FRAMING: one single subject, centred, filling about 70% of a square canvas, with generous even margin on all sides and nothing touching the edge. BACKGROUND: a perfectly flat, uniform #FF00FF magenta, edge to edge, with no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow and no vignette; magenta is ground only and is keyed out afterwards, so it must never appear inside the subject. Save the raw image; do not crop, resize, recolour or post-process it.
